canonical_example.text: El perro tenía una herida en su brazo que el veterinario tuvo que cerrar con puntos de sutura.
canonical_example.translation: The dog had a wound on its front leg that the veterinarian had to close up with stitches.

canonical_example.text: Los brazos del río se extienden a cuatro países diferentes.
canonical_example.translation: The branches of the river extend to four different countries.

canonical_example.text: Tráeme las llaves, por favor.
canonical_example.translation: Bring me the keys, please.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué traes en esta maleta tan pesada?
canonical_example.translation: What are you carrying in that heavy suitcase?

canonical_example.text: La novia trae un vestido blanco largo con encaje delicado.
canonical_example.translation: The bride is wearing a long, white dress with delicate lace.

canonical_example.text: Este periódico no trae crucigrama.
canonical_example.translation: This newspaper doesn't have a crossword.

canonical_example.text: ¿No sabes que hacer eso trae mala suerte?
canonical_example.translation: Don't you know that doing that brings bad luck?

canonical_example.text: Tiré tus jeans viejos. ¡Estaban traídos!
canonical_example.translation: I threw away your old jeans. They were worn!

canonical_example.text: El vagabundo tenía barba larga y ropa traída.
canonical_example.translation: The vagabond had a long beard and worn-out clothes.

canonical_example.text: No traigo dinero. ¿Me prestas?
canonical_example.translation: I don't have any money on me. Can you lend me some?

canonical_example.text: La recesión trajo un alto nivel de desempleo.
canonical_example.translation: The recession brought a high level of unemployment.

canonical_example.text: La inundación de las calles trajo muchos problemas de congestión.
canonical_example.translation: The flooding of the streets caused serious traffic problems.

canonical_example.text: Me trae preocupada la noticia de la caída de la bolsa.
canonical_example.translation: The news of the market crash is making me nervous.

canonical_example.text: ¡Ese ruido me trae loco!
canonical_example.translation: That noise is driving me crazy!

canonical_example.text: Oye, ¿qué traes? - No traigo nada; solo estoy muy cansado.
canonical_example.translation: Hey, what's wrong with you? - Nothing's wrong with me; I'm just really tired.

canonical_example.text: Me traje dos trajes de baño por si vamos mucho a la playa.
canonical_example.translation: I brought two bathing suits in case we go to the beach a lot.

canonical_example.text: Tráete el perro cuando vamos al parque.
canonical_example.translation: Bring the dog along when we go to the park.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué se trae Carlitos? Lleva una sonrisa traviesa.
canonical_example.translation: What's Carlitos up to? He has a mischievous grin on his face.
